biggest_catch: You must park $1,000 of new money and keep at least $1,000 in the account through January 31, 2027 — this is a multi-month balance lockup for a $100 bonus, and fees can erode the eligible balance.
catches: Only available if you qualify for the checking offer (R5884) — the savings bonus requires qualifying for the checking offer first.
Requires $1,000+ in new-money deposits by October 29, 2026, and maintaining a $1,000+ minimum balance through January 31, 2027; fees reduce the eligible balance.
New U.S. Bank consumer savings/money market customers only; none closed in past 12 months; no savings bonus in past 12 months.
Must open through the campus promotional page or eligible campus branch (banker activation).
Bonus credited within 30 days after all requirements are completed; account must be open with a positive balance; reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Cannot be combined with any other savings account bonus offers; limit one checking and savings bonus per tax ID.
$5 monthly maintenance fee (waived when paired with Bank Smartly Checking).

steps: Qualify for the U.S. Bank campus Smartly Checking offer (R5884).
Open a new U.S. Bank Smartly Savings account through the campus promotional page between May 5, 2026 and October 29, 2026, funding at least $25 within 60 days.
Make $1,000 or more in new-money deposits by October 29, 2026, then maintain a minimum $1,000 balance through January 31, 2027.
The $100 savings bonus is credited within 30 days after all requirements are completed; keep the account open with a positive balance until payout.
timing: Open by October 29, 2026; $1,000+ deposits by October 29, 2026; maintain $1,000+ through January 31, 2027; bonus within 30 days after requirements complete.
